newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA KEEPS HELSINKI HEX ABOVE 3,000, OTHERS SLIDE.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA KEEPS HELSINKI HEX ABOVE 3,000, OTHERS SLIDE.

text.p: Finnish shares were hit by
profit-taking Tuesday afternoon after starting at life-highs,
with other European bourses off highs and Wall Street starting
lower, but the broad picture was supported by Nokia's strength.
The HEX index stayed above the 3,000-point mark all session
and closed at 3,006.36 points, up 0.95 but off its 3,019.61
point intra-session record. The FOX derivatives and portfolio
benchmark index closed at 1.051.58, up 0.56 percent.
"The fact that we passed the 3,000 level was probably a sell
signal for some players," said one broker, but he added that the
HEX would stay above 3,000 if supported by Wall Street.
Among forestries, UPM-Kymmene closed at 115.00
markka, down 1.00 markka, Metsa-Serla was down 0.10
markka at 42.90, but Enso reversed losses that came
after its 1996 results on Monday -- up 0.60 markka at 45.90
"once investors had digested the report," said one broker.
Pharmaceuticals wholesaler Tamro rose after it
broke resistance at 34 markka to close up 0.60 at 34.60, though
some brokers were disappointed with its 0.90 markka dividend.
Insurer Sampo rose 3.00 markka to 455.00 as
investors switched from rival Pohjola which fell 0.55
markka to 143.70 in lively dealings.
"Some investors have been switching some of their Pohjola
for Sampo," one broker said, adding that investors were adding
Sampo to their portfolio in continued anticipation of
restructuring in Nordic financial indsutry.
Paper machine maker Valmet was also active,
falling 0.30 markka to 91.00. "Investors' views on Valmet have
probably changed," one broker said.
The share has risen from 80.00 markka this year but has in
the last two weeks inched down from a 97.10 peak.
